objective: Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

description: Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.
I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
completion: Hmm, this news is troubling. Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.
If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
